W1971209286.abstract: Abstract A phthalonitrile derivative 1 , functionalized with two pyridyl groups, undergoes a cyclotetramerization reaction to afford the symmetric metal‐free phthalocyanine 2 peripheral metal‐binding sites. The compounds 5 – 9 were synthesized by statistical condensation between different phthalonitriles, remarkably, all them have isolated characterized as single compounds. W2949960920.title: Multifunctional Materials Based on Tetrathiafulvalene Derivatives with Binding Sites for Metal Ions
W2949960920.abstract: Tetrathiafulvalene (TTF) and its derivatives are very well known as reversible, stable two-electron donors they have found widespread use in the field of organic conductors superconductors. Further, during last decades, developments synthetic TTF chemistry enabled versatile building blocks new fields materials supramolecular chemistry. This brief review relates some recent advances that been achieved by combining redox conducting properties with other functionalities, such magnetism or optical properties. A variety TTF-based ligand systems their metal complexes presented.

W2094022094.title: Synthesis and Electrochemical and Photophysical Studies of Tetrathiafulvalene-Annulated Phthalocyanines
W2094022094.abstract: The synthesis of tetrakis(tetrathiafulvalene)-annulated metal-free and metallophthalocyanines 5-8 via the tetramerization phthalonitrile derivative 4 is reported. All them have been fully characterized by electronic absorption spectroscopy, thin-layer cyclic voltammetry, mass spectrometry, elemental analysis. Their solution electrochemical data show two reversible four-electron oxidation waves, indicating that these fused systems are strong pi-electron donors, which give rise to tetra- or octaradical cation species. For phthalocyanine 5, additionally a one-electron wave was found in negative direction arising from reduction macrocycle. Moreover, tetrathiafulvalene unit acts as an efficient reductive electron-transfer quencher for emission, but upon its oxidation, intense luminescence switched on.
